title: ScienceLabRunReceipt/v1
description: A receipt tying together an engine run and its (optional) validation into a single terminal run outcome, carrying the honest terminal status and the aggregate resource usage. The receipt binds a run_request_id to an engine_receipt_id and an optional validation_receipt_id (null when no validation ran), names the terminal_status (completed / failed / wait_capability / wait_resource / inconclusive), and records the aggregate resource_usage (wall_seconds, rss_bytes, output_bytes). A run with terminal_status=completed SHOULD carry a non-null validation_receipt_id (a completed run is one whose output was checked); a run without validation is at best inconclusive. The receipt carries the two safety consts (canonical_writes=0, grants_authority=false). Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

receipt_id.description: Content-addressed identity: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the receipt (without this field), prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by the python receipt builder.

run_request_id.description: The object_id of the run request this run receipt closes out. Ties the engine run and the validation back to the request that originated the computation.

engine_receipt_id.description: The receipt_id of the ScienceLabEngineReceipt/v1 this run receipt wraps. The engine run is the compute half of the run.

validation_receipt_id.description: The receipt_id of the ScienceLabValidationReceipt/v1 that checked the engine output, or null when no validation ran. A terminal_status=completed run SHOULD carry a non-null validation_receipt_id (a completed run is one whose output was checked).

terminal_status.description: The terminal outcome of the run: completed (engine ran and output checked), failed (engine ran and failed), wait_capability (blocked on a missing capability — capability_state not ready), wait_resource (blocked on a resource), inconclusive (ran but no definitive scientific verdict). NOT a validation verdict — completed only means the run closed out, not that the claim is supported.

resource_usage.description: Aggregate resource usage of the run (engine + validation). All fields are non-negative integers.

rss_bytes.description: Peak resident set size in bytes across the run, >= 0.

output_bytes.description: Total output bytes produced (the serialized output objects), >= 0.

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at seconds precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No offset, no fractional seconds.

canonical_writes.description: Safety const: a receipt is immutable once authored. Always 0; a non-zero value is a contract violation.

grants_authority.description: Safety const: a receipt never grants authority on its own. Always false; a true value is a contract violation. A completed run is still an admission of a closed-out run, not an authorization to act on the claim.
